content.text: Keep a small library of books: each has a title, an author, a rating from 1 to 5 and a read flag. Users add and edit books and see them all in one list sorted by rating, best first; books already read stay in the list but are shown greyed out.
IN: one entity, Book, and one screen listing all books, best rated first.
OUT: multiple libraries, borrowing, genres, author as its own entity, import/export.
None — keeping the book rows through the screen.
R1: The system SHALL list all books in one list sorted by rating, highest first.
R2: WHILE a book's read flag is set, the system SHALL show its row greyed out in the list, without removing it.
Rules the table cannot carry: none.
A single list of all books, best rating first; read books appear greyed out. A selected row is edited in a side panel; new books are added from the same screen.

cells.text: one row per Book: title, author, rating, read; sorted by rating descending; read rows greyed

content.text: None — no existing entity or spec covers books.
Considered, none apply: authorization beyond the platform default, performance, volume, availability, audit, privacy, locale, cost.
A1 (verifies R1): WHEN books with ratings 3, 5 and 4 exist, the list SHALL show them in the order 5, 4, 3.
A2 (verifies R2): WHEN a book with read set and a book with read unset exist, the list SHALL show both, with only the read one greyed out.
None — new entity, nothing to migrate.
